name: content-cards-plugin
description: This is a plugin that extends Obsidian content rendering types, such as: timeline, highlightblock, target card, book info card, music info card, movie info card, photoes ablum, business card, content subfield, countdown, etc.
author: leo

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const files = ['main.js', 'styles.css', 'data.json']; files.forEach(file => { if (fs.existsSync(file)) { fs.unlinkSync(file); console.log('Deleted:', file); } });"
